name: Macomb County, MI
findings: Macomb County has 1,830 nonprofit organizations. 737 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 569 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Macomb County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few research and think tank organizations list membership
observations.text: 8 research and think tank organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 27 would.

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
